epigraph: The eye seeks the flame but finds only smoke.
vignette: The Verdant scribe pressed his stylus into the mud. He sought to bind the Veilwisp. The ink sank deep into the soil. The ground accepted the mark. Then the mark vanished. No force erased it. The truth simply refused to hold. The Umbral commander watched from the ridge. He saw nothing happen. His archers drew their bows. They aimed at the empty space where the scribe stood. The arrows passed through the air. They struck the dirt behind him. The Veilwisp drifted upward. It was a small light. It burned with the cold fire of the Rift. It moved between the soldiers. It brushed against their armor. The metal felt no heat. The soldiers felt no touch. The ground beneath them remained unchanged. The Aspect did not fight. It did not resist. It simply existed outside the reach of will. The scribe fell to his knees. He realized his error. You cannot command what refuses to be known. The light faded into the grey sky. The mud remained dry. The truth of the Veilwisp is absence. It hides in the blind spot of conviction.
codex_note: The Veilwisp renders the ground immune to direct alteration by existing outside the perceptual scope of opposing rites.
